prompt: What was the title of the engineer and scientist Ahmet Cemal Eringen's Ph.D. dissertation?
answer:
Ahmet Cemal Eringen’s Ph.D. dissertation was titled:

**“Solution of the Two-Dimensional Mixed Boundary-Value Problem of Elasticity for Rectangular Orthotropic Media and Application to the Buckling of Sandwich Beams.”**

(Some records render “mixed boundary-value” as “mixed-mixed boundary value.”)
